question: In archery, what is the maximum time permitted to shoot an end of three arrows?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 minutes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In archery, the time limit to shoot an end of three arrows is **2 minutes**.
 
• This rule ensures that competitions proceed at a steady pace and prevents unnecessary delays.
 
• It also ensures that archers manage their time effectively and maintain their focus under time pressure.
 
• The 2-minute rule is standardized across various archery tournaments to ensure consistency and fairness in the sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **End**

 
 
• An 'end' in archery refers to a set number of arrows shot before scores are tallied and arrows are retrieved.
 
• In most competitions, an end consists of three or six arrows.
 
• The time allowed to shoot these arrows is fixed to ensure the competition moves smoothly.
 
 
 
• **Scoring in Archery**
 
 
• Each arrow shot scores points based on where it lands on the target.
 
• Targets are marked with concentric circles, with the innermost circle scoring the highest points (usually 10 points).
 
• The total score for an end is the sum of the points from all arrows shot in that end.
 
 
 
• **Time Management**
 
 
• Effective time management is crucial in archery to ensure that all arrows are shot within the allotted time.
 
• Archers often practice shooting within the time limit to develop a consistent rhythm and avoid time-related penalties.
 
• Penalties for exceeding the time limit can include point deductions or disqualification of the end.
 
 
 
• **Standardization of Rules**
 
 
• Archery competitions follow standardized rules set by governing bodies such as World Archery (WA).
 
• These rules ensure consistency and fairness across different events and competitions.
 
• The 2-minute rule for shooting three arrows is one such standardized rule.
